── §8 bets · Bets ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Bet 1 (lead): Progressive deploys with canary gates
  evidence: Both outages hit 100% of traffic at once.
  build: 1% → 10% → 100% with automatic rollback on canary red.
  pre-mortem: Fails if canaries miss payment-specific paths; add Apple Pay to the canary first.
  target: Worst outage < 1 h · change failure < 10%

   Recommendation: run the bake-off; the renewal deadline allows it.
